label: greenhouse gas emission reduction
definition: A reduction in emissions of greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide, compared with a reference.
comment: Renewable generation avoids the emissions of the fossil generation it replaces; the reduction is usually given in tonnes of CO2 equivalent per year.

label: visual impact
definition: A change in the appearance of a landscape caused by an installation.
comment: Visual impact is a common objection to wind turbines and is considered in spatial planning, for example through buffer zones from the coast.

label: electricity access
definition: The provision of electricity to people or households that lack it.
comment: Off-grid and mini-grid renewable systems are a main route to rural electrification in sub-Saharan Africa.

label: water access
definition: The provision of drinking or irrigation water to people, made possible by an energy system.
comment: For example, wind-powered pumps can supply water to a given number of inhabitants.

label: socioeconomic well-being
definition: An improvement in the living conditions and welfare of a community.
comment: It covers combined benefits such as better access to water, sanitation, health services and income opportunities.

label: cost saving
definition: A reduction in the cost of energy or services compared with existing options.
comment: For example, a low-wind-speed turbine may offer cheaper energy than diesel generation.

label: energy generation
definition: The amount of energy that an energy system or resource can produce.
comment: It may be electrical or mechanical energy and is often reported as a potential for a site or a region.

label: demand coverage
definition: The share of an energy demand that can be met by an energy system or resource.
comment: For example, an offshore wind scenario could cover a given percentage of national electricity demand.

label: energy substitution
definition: The replacement of one energy source by another.
comment: For example, wind power may replace part of the electricity produced from fossil fuels.

label: energy independence
definition: A reduction in dependence on imported or external energy sources.
comment: Local renewable resources can reduce reliance on imported fuels and support energy security.
